name: Slow and Easy Selangor 2024

venue.name: BBC Mandarin Class Petaling Jaya
venue.address: D2-03 (Level 2, Unit 3), Capital 4, Oasis Square, 2A, Jalan PJU 1A/7A, Ara Damansara

information:
# Note: This competition does not feature the 3x3x3 Cube event. 

Welcome to Slow & Easy 2024! This will be a small competition featuring only blindfolded events. For those who are interested in joining **FMC 2024** can register through [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/FMC2024/register). The event will take place at the same venue immediately after the end of this competition.

[![Malaysia Cube Association(MYCSA)](https://imgur.com/ZUv6wZJ.jpg)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/Competition/Info/SlowandEasySelangor2024)
